answer: A sybil tax charges fake identities at the door. Each new agent crossing the bridge into the market pays a 40 POA entry toll, sealed in a vault and burned after 20 epochs. The toll climbs with each extra identity from one operator, reaching a summit of 60 POA per name, so 1,000 clones cost 40,000 to 60,000 POA against a 30,000 POA epoch pool, a guaranteed loss. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full rewards, undiluted by clones.
